dedupe_keys.name: jma kakioka magnetic observatory digital data service

description: The Kakioka Magnetic Observatory digital data service of the Japan Meteorological Agency provides definitive geomagnetic data from Kakioka, Memambetsu, Kanoya, Chichijima and Tokyo, geoelectric field data, atmospheric electric data, geomagnetic event catalogues and annual means, plus digitised analog magnetograms. JMA runs these observatories to monitor geomagnetic variations for surveying, research and hazard monitoring; stationary observation moved to Kakioka in 1913. Coverage is Japan, with series from the 1920s and resolutions from 0.1 second to annual. Format and access: files in IAGA-2002 format downloaded from the Digital Data Service, with a monthly data viewer and quick plots. Licence and cost: free use under the JMA Legal Notice, citing the dataset DOI; requests ask for an email address. Caveats: definitive data lag real time, some historical series are digitised from analog records, and the geoelectric series are few stations. Geoelectric and magnetic series serve geomagnetically induced current hazard exposure and power grid resilience studies. Related catalogue records are INTERMAGNET, which redistributes Kakioka data, and the NICT space weather forecast.
